shortDescription: Manage port lists on BIG-IP AFM

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the port list.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: port_lists
options.description: Simple list of existing port lists to add to this list. Port lists can be specified in either their fully qualified name (/Common/foo) or their short name (foo). If a short name is used, the C(partition) argument will automatically be prepended to the short name.

options.name: port_ranges
options.description: A list of port ranges where the range starts with a port number, is followed by a dash (-), and then a second number. If the first number is greater than the second number, the numbers will be reversed to be properly formatted, for example 90-78 would become 78-90.

options.name: ports
options.description: Simple list of port values to add to the list.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the address list and entries exists. When C(absent), ensures the address list is removed.
